title: Needs
description: Needs per tier (CONTENT §2, §11, MECHANICS §6.2). A need is a goods need (a category with acceptable goods), a building need (D-056: alternative public buildings of the tier or below that serve the house within their service radius) or a chain need (D-065: chain + min_rank, served by any building of a service chain with rank >= min_rank within its own radius). Every acceptable good and every building alternative has a share (D-056): category coverage = min(1, sum of the shares of the supplied alternatives x their supply ratio). The share is optional: when absent the loader uses 1.0 for a lone alternative and 0.6 for each of two or more; an authored share wins. kind: required needs count toward satisfaction (own-tier required weights sum to 1; see from_tier for lower-tier categories); optional needs are shown but have no effect (the optional tax bonus was removed by D-056). name is the player-facing name (1–32 printable characters; display data only); a goods need's category must be listed in need_categories.json.

from_tier.description: Cumulative tiers (D-056): set on a lower tier's goods category carried by this tier; per_resident_per_min is the lower rate and weight the category's weight in from_tier. The loader normalises the weights: the tier's own categories share 0.6, the lower tiers 0.4 (equally per tier, then by weight).

chain.description: Service chain of a chain need (D-065): served when any building of the chain with rank >= min_rank reaches the house within its own radius. Needs a category and min_rank.

min_rank.description: Minimum rank of the chain building that serves a chain need (D-065).

share.description: Coverage contributed by this alternative at full supply (D-056; default 1.0 for a lone alternative, 0.6 otherwise).
